_comment: Mirror-COPY. MirrorTool reads context.selected, so the geometry MUST be selected BEFORE activating Mirror + the two mirror-axis clicks; an empty selection no-ops every click. mirrorKeepOriginal defaults true => a COPY (original + reflection both remain). We draw an asymmetric L (two lines, ids 1 & 2), select all, then mirror across the vertical axis x=120 (axis points [120,-50]->[120,150]). After commit the entity count goes UP by the mirrored copies (assert: entityCount 4 = 2 originals + 2 copies); the two copies appear mirrored on the far side of x=120.
